notes.summary: Calendar questions use odd days (extra days after full weeks) to find a day of the week. Clock questions use the speeds of the hands. Usually 0–1 question.

concepts.title: Odd days
concepts.body:
Ordinary year = 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 odd day. Leap year = 2 odd days. Month odd days: 31 days → 3, 30 days → 2, February → 0 (or 1 in a leap year).
Odd days in 100 years = 5, 200 = 3, 300 = 1, 400 = 0.

concepts.title: Leap year
concepts.body: A year divisible by 4 is a leap year; a century year (1900, 2100) must be divisible by 400 (2000 is a leap year, 1900 is not).

concepts.title: Clock hands
concepts.body: Minute hand moves 6° per minute; hour hand moves 0.5° per minute. Angle at H hours M minutes = |30H − 5.5M|. Hands meet every 65 5/11 minutes.

varieties.name: Day of the week
varieties.how: Count odd days between the two dates and move forward that many days.

example.q: 1 Jan 2025 is Wednesday. What day is 1 Feb 2025?

varieties.name: Angle between hands
varieties.how: Use θ = |30H − 5.5M|; if more than 180°, take 360° − θ.

varieties.name: Hands together / opposite
varieties.how: Hands together between H and H+1 at (60H/11) minutes past H.

example.q: When are the hands together between 2 and 3?

tips: Mirror time = 11:60 − given time (for times between 1:00 and 11:00).
traps: When moving one year forward, the extra day of a leap year counts only if 29 February lies in between.

questions.q: If 1 January 2025 was a Wednesday, what day of the week was 1 March 2025?
questions.solution:
Days from 1 January to 1 March = 31 (Jan) + 28 (Feb, 2025 is not a leap year) = 59.
59 = 8 weeks + 3 odd days.
Wednesday + 3 = Saturday.

questions.q: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 3:30?
If 15 August 2023 was a Tuesday, what day of the week was 15 August 2024?
questions.solution:
From 15 Aug 2023 to 15 Aug 2024 the period includes 29 February 2024.
So it has 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 odd days.
Tuesday + 2 = Thursday.

questions.q: What is the angle between the two hands of a clock at 7:20?
At what time between 4 o'clock and 5 o'clock will the hands of a clock be together?
questions.solution:
At 4:00 the hour hand is 20 minute-spaces ahead.
The minute hand gains 11/12 of a minute-space every minute.
Time = 20 × 12/11 = 240/11 = 21 9/11 minutes past 4.

questions.q: What day of the week was 26 January 1950?
questions.solution:
Odd days up to 31 Dec 1949:
1600 years → 0; next 300 years → 1; 49 years = 12 leap + 37 ordinary → 24 + 37 = 61 → 61 mod 7 = 5.
Total so far = 0 + 1 + 5 = 6.
26 January → 26 mod 7 = 5.
Total = 11 → 11 mod 7 = 4 → Thursday (Sunday = 0).
